arxiv-2108-11126.title: YANMTT: Yet Another Neural Machine Translation Toolkit
arxiv-2108-11126.creator: Raj Dabre Eiichiro Sumita
arxiv-2108-11126.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Raj Dabre Eiichiro Sumita. In this paper we present our open-source neural machine translation (NMT) toolkit called ‘‘Yet Another Neural Machine Translation Toolkit’’ abbreviated as YANMTT 1 1 1 https://github.com/prajdabre/yanmtt which is built on top of the Transformers library. Despite the growing importance of sequence to sequence pre-training there surprisingly few, if not none, well established toolkits that allow users to easily do pre-training. Toolkits such as Fairseq which do allow pre-training, have very large codebases and thus they are not beginner friendly.

arxiv-2301-01818.description: Abstract We introduce and analyze a Statically Condensed Iterated Penalty (SCIP) method for solving incompressible flow problems discretized with p p th-order Scott-Vogelius elements. pmc-10513287.title: Inpatient versus Outpatient Immediate Alloplastic Breast Reconstruction: Recent Trends, Outcomes, and Safety
pmc-10513287.creator: Andrea K. Little, Darin L. Patmon, Harminder Sandhu, Shannon Armstrong, Daniella Anderson, Megan Sommers
pmc-10513287.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background:Immediate alloplastic breast reconstruction was traditionally performed as an inpatient procedure. pmc-10534561.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Besides genetic factors and energy-related behaviors, psycho-cultural factors are also important in obesity etiology. Previous studies have suggested that improving body image might be an effective method for managing body weight. Thus, this study aimed to evaluate the effects of a multifaceted intervention on the body image of children and explore whether body image played a mediating role in changes in adiposity indicators.

pmc-10578187.description: The human pathogen Streptococcus pyogenes (Group A Streptococcus, GAS) is responsible for invasive disease characterized by inflammation and tissue destruction. Inflammatory symptoms of invasive disease may be attributed to the neutrophil response during the early stages of infection. Here, the human neutrophil response to GAS was characterized in vitro using emm98.1 type covS mutant GAS strain NS88.

pmc-11502464.creator: Timothy J. Wade, Carly Herbert
pmc-11502464.description: Legionellosis is a respiratory infection caused by Legionella sp. that is found in water and soil. Infection may cause pneumonia (Legionnaires’ Disease) and a milder form (Pontiac Fever). Legionella colonizes water systems and results in exposure by inhalation of aerosolized bacteria. The incubation period ranges from 2 to 14 days. Precipitation and humidity may be associated with increased risk.

pmc-13402630.title: Impact of adopting digital FinTech techniques on banks’ cyber and systemic risks
pmc-13402630.creator: Hussein Ahmed Alshari, Ebrahim M Almogahed, Mazen M Al-mekhlafi
pmc-13402630.description: The rapid advancement of financial technology (FinTech) mandates a thorough investigation into its adverse effects, focusing on cyber risks and systemic vulnerabilities. pmc-13430907.title: Point-of-care ultrasound evaluation of obstructive azoospermia in a patient with prior bilateral Cohen ureteral reimplantation: A case report
pmc-13430907.creator: Shlomi Barak, Netanel Waldenberg, Guy Bar, Oshri Barel, Snir Dekalo, Atef Zeadna, Benzion Samueli, Guy Shrem
pmc-13430907.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundObstructive azoospermia (OA) is a potentially treatable cause of male infertility. Point-of-care ultrasonography (POCUS) has emerged as a valuable adjunct in the evaluation of male infertility, enabling rapid identification of sonographic findings suggestive of reproductive tract obstruction. We describe the use of scrotal POCUS in the evaluation of OA in a man with a history of infantile bilateral Cohen cross-trigonal ureteral reimplantation for severe vesicoureteral reflux.Case presentationA 32-year-old man presented with primary infertility and azoospermia, with normal semen volume and pH.

pmc-13470266.description: This study aimed to assess diagnostic values of kinetic parameters in ultrafast dynamic contrast magnetic resonance imaging. The diagnostic performance of ultrafast kinetic parameters (time to enhancement [TTE], maximum slope [MS], time to peak, peak enhancement [PE], and wash-in slope [WIS]), and their correlations with the immunohistopathological findings of breast cancer were evaluated for 101 histologically proven breast lesions.
